'''Kallimethra''' is one of the religions of [[Andah]]. Its principal denominations include [[Therameth]], [[Anakalli]], [[Doxis]], [[Suyuwira]] and [[Kayamuya]].

==Denominations==
* [[Therameth]]
* [[Anakalli]]

* [[Kayamuya]]
